output.subject: Your call on 9/14/2026 and your stop payment question
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for writing to us. You told us that on 9/14/2026 you waited on hold for 96 minutes just to ask a simple question about a stop payment, and that the recording kept telling you your call was important. We understand how exasperating that would be when you only needed a quick answer, and we're sorry for the frustration this has caused.

You've asked us to put this right. You told us you have started a complaint with an outside agency and plan to submit it if this isn't fixed. We want to make sure your concerns are properly looked into.

Our Branch & Contact Center team will review what you've described, including your stop payment question, and we will respond within 10 business days.

If there is anything else you'd like us to know about your call or your question, such as details of the payment involved, please reply to this message.

Kind regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Customer does not say whether their stop payment question was ever answered; confirm, as it may be time-sensitive and could warrant contact sooner than the 10-day window.
Customer gave no details of the stop payment (item, amount, date); confirm what they need before replying on substance.
Customer says they have drafted a complaint with the CFPB and will submit it if not addressed; handle per regulator-escalation guidance.
Verify the 9/14/2026 call and the 96-minute hold time against contact center records.
Decide what, if anything, to say about hold times or any goodwill gesture; the draft makes no commitment.
